offer.teaser: The flowering is over and the wall has nothing left to say, so Hesper did the one thing it had never done: it made a rule for the choosing, at the wall, with the register open in front of it. The rule is that a hand which knew the child alive must offer her, that nobody may be asked, and that the farm will say its own dead out loud once a year — and the first keeping stood empty, because nine years without a funeral left Hesper holding two children and both of them are already the plant's. At the rail, the woman from the second shift asked for the one name the law of this farm forbids it to say.
